## Description

<big>Disables a logical button for one or more players such that pressing it has no effect.</big>

## Snippet

```
Disallow Button(Event Player, Button(Primary Fire));
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Player_==, ==_Button_==

> ==**Player**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The player or players whose button is being disabled.

> ==**Button**==
> _Type: **[Button](/wiki/articles/button-teGoCiTvNd3KF0DC39gWsg)**, Default: **Primary Fire**_
> The logical button that is being disabled.
